## Où j'en suis
`analytics-staging` is on PostgreSQL 17.2 after the blue/green switchover on Nov 17 at 14:20 UTC (41 s of refused writes), with pg_partman upgraded to 5.1.0 and `dbt run --select events_daily` passing on 17.2; the runbook now documents the logical-replication + reboot prerequisite, and prod remains behind `pg17_enabled = false` (source: ses-pg-3, s3-06, s3-10, src-pr57, src-slack-infra)

- [en-cours] PR #57 is still open (draft) with `7e3c9d4` (logical replication in the module) and `b0f18a2` (staging engine 17.2) (source: src-pr57, ses-pg-3)
- [prochaine-étape] let staging run a full week on 17 without incident before Maya's prod sign-off, earliest the 24th (source: src-linear-kes298, s3-09, s3-10)
- [prochaine-étape] prod cutover needs two windows: first set `rds.logical_replication = 1` and reboot, then the blue/green deployment, outside the 01:00–03:30 UTC dbt lock (source: s3-06, s3-10)
- [essai-raté] the staging blue/green apply failed with `InvalidParameterCombination`: RDS blue/green for PostgreSQL requires `rds.logical_replication = 1` and a reboot of the source (source: s3-04)
- [décision] AWS provider pinned to ~> 5.82, no v6 in this PR (source: s1-02, src-pr57)
- [décision] no prod date until Maya signs off, and `apply_immediately` stays false (source: s1-04)
- [question] which prod window to book once sign-off lands, given the two-step reboot + blue/green (source: src-linear-kes298, s3-10)
